notes.title: Future update plans
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I'm Bing X, the developer of Dark Hunting Ground.
First of all, thank all hunters for your feedback and support since the 1.0 release of Dark Hunting Ground. Thank you so much!
Many hunters have been curious about future updates and what specific content will be included. During my few days off, I've received many suggestions.
The framework of Dark Hunting is relatively complete, and many of my expectations, ideas, and creativity have been successfully implemented into the game. This is why I'm planning to release it to the 1.0 version.
Of course, the game still has many issues that need optimization and adjustment, which will be the focus of updates over the next few days.

[b]The following are some planned improvements and features: (The order does not represent the order of update time)[/b]
[list]
[*] In-game encyclopedia with detailed explanations of various mechanics
[*] You can set which resources to display in the lower right corner
[*] Display drop-restricted indicators on item entries
[*] Added the ability to search by the number of quality modifiers in the search function
[*] When creating a new build preset page, you can create a completely new, blank page
[*] Added the ability to export filters as code and import them as code
[*] Added an option to block low-quality orders
[*] When a new save is in progress, you can skip the conversation if it has already occurred in another save
[*] The automatic placement of items in the inventory can now be selected in multiple inventory locations
[*] Fix bugs
[/list]

[b]At the same time, there are some unconfirmed plans, including:[/b]
[list]
[*] Occasionally create new Relics, Slates, Cores, Abyss Eyes, and Skills. This depends mainly on whether I have new ideas or inspiration.
[*] Mod support. Since I have no prior experience, it may take me quite some time to learn this.
[/list]
[u]Hunters with ideas for new items, or those with experience in the Mod Support, are welcome to contact me for further discussion! [/u]

Dark Hunting Grounds won't be updated forever, and I'll continue working on the next game after completing this one. 
But until it's fully polished, I'll continue to get feedback from hunters and refine the existing experience.
Also, welcome to leave your ideas, suggestions, and feedback in the comments section or anywhere else we can find them.
Thank you all for your support. Thank you very much!

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE: Item Filter, Drop/Crafting/Merchant Adjustment, Lag Optimization
notes.notes:
[h3]Great Hunters!​​[/h3]

[u]Dark Hunting Ground has finally received its second major update![/u]
This comprehensive overhaul aims to optimize the entire gameplay experience and enhance the value of late-game item drops.

[b]Below are the detailed changes:[/b]

[u]Disassemble Retention (Item Filter System):​​[/u]
Added customizable ​Item Retention Rules. Items matching your criteria will no longer be auto-disassembled.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968315/3fe62b02447731cd372953f10fe272c9549d3b36.png[/img]

[u]Drop-Exclusive Affixes:​​[/u]
Equipment has always been a core driver of progression. But in Dark Hunting Ground, late-game drops in previous versions felt underwhelming. To address this, we’ve revamped the loot and crafting systems.

​Chaos-tier items​ now drop starting at ​Orange Skull 1​ difficulty.
Added ​new chaos drop-exclusive affixes​ and converted older affixes to ​drop-exclusive status. These powerful affixes can ​only​ be obtained via drops, and items with multiple drop-exclusive affixes will be ​extremely rare.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968315/6957b2c0c10005bf0cf7fb9312265cb7e0bca7d0.png[/img]

[u][b]These changes will not affect existing items[/b][/u]

New Chaos-tier exclusive drop affixes:

Relic:
(10%-20%) of Damage Taken is taken from Mana before Life
(5%-10%) of Elemental Damage taken is treated as Normal Damage
+(5%-10%) Dark Tree's Power effect
+(1%-3%) Maximum Elemental Resistance
+(5%-10%) Damage Reduction
+(1-4) Minimum of Focus
Critical Damage penetrates (8%-12%) Defense
Each Elemental Ailments on target make you deal (3%-5%) more Damage
(18%-36%) chance to apply 1 additional stack on Apply poison
+(1-2) Maximum of Over Time Damage Aggravation
The Damage over time you deal initially has (1-4) aggravations
+(5-10) Maximum of Armor Break

Slate:
(8%-12%) more Normal Damage
(8%-12%) more Fire Damage
(8%-12%) more Cold Damage
(8%-12%) more Lightning Damage
(20%-40%) chance to do Melee Attack 1 more time
(20%-40%) chance to fire 1 additional Projectile
+(3%-5%) Skill Power
+1 Maximum number of summons
+(1-2) The number of summons per Summon
(15%-25%) more Critical Rate
(8%-12%) more Critical Damage
+1 Projectile Chains Times

The following affixes are now drop-exclusive and cannot be obtained through crafting:[/h2]

Relic:
+n% Block Damage Reduction (Roll range adjusted: 4-5% → 3-5%)
+n% Maximum Normal Resistance (Roll range adjusted: 4-5% → 3-9%)
+n% Maximum Fire Resistance (Roll range adjusted: 4-5% → 3-9%)
+n% Maximum Cold Resistance (Roll range adjusted: 4-5% → 3-9%)
+n% Maximum Lightning Resistance (Roll range adjusted: 4-5% → 3-9%)
+n Maximum of Fury (Roll range adjusted: 3-3 → 1-3)
+n Maximum of Focus (Roll range adjusted: 3-3 → 1-3)
+n Maximum of Haste (Roll range adjusted: 2-2 → 1-1)
+n Maximum Spirit Power

Core:
+n% Drop Quality Up Rate (Roll range adjusted: 3%-3% → 1%-1%)

​Crafting Adjustments:​​
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968315/3f78523beb03092419f40895604f7c4e70017201.png[/img]
Removed Item Spirituality.
Crafting without affix locking now consumes Crystals one tier lower than the item's quality. Affix locking consumes Crystals of the same tier.
​Locked affix count no longer affects resource costs​ (locking 1 vs. 3 affixes costs the same).
Chaos-tier items can now undergo ​Normal Crafting, but their Chaos affixes are ​permanently locked.

Chaos System Changes:​​
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968315/7617e38fba57b0f52382db1576b1cd8c8b0fa653.png[/img]
Removed Item Chaos System.
Removed Item Breakdown.
Added Deeply Chaos System(unlocked at Orange Skull 1 difficulty)
Chaos-tier items can consume Void Breath, Perfect Void Crystals, and Chaos Crystals to double a random affix value. 
Deeply Chaosed items cannot undergo further Deeply Chaos or Normal Crafting but can still be modified via Remains.

Remains Adjustments:​​
Remains are now unlocked at Purple Skull 1 difficulty.
Remains - Eternal Frost Heart effect adjusted: Retains up to 2 affixes when converting an item to another of the same type.
Remains - Nirvana Fire effect adjusted: Restores a Deeply Chaosed item.

​Merchant System Revamp:​​
Merchants were underutilized in late-game. This update reworks their role to be impactful throughout all stages.
Removed ​VIP System; its perks are now unlocked via difficulty progression.

Shop Changes:​​
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968315/ba336ea2717954f4c886442f4ada547fa4b13c58.png[/img]
Added ​Chaos-tier goods​ to merchants.
​Added auto-retention settings​ for shop items based on quality.
Unlock ​Shop Slot 1​ at Green Skull 1 and ​Shop Slot 2​ at Purple Skull 1.

​Crystal Exchange:​​
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968315/33cf79133909c0b34ba6e95444238b357d2e7ad0.png[/img]
​Basic Crystal Exchange​ is now unlocked by default; 
​Advanced Exchange​ unlocks at Green Skull 1.
Low-to-high-tier Crystal exchange ratio changed to ​5:1​ (was 10:1).
Added ​​"Convert All"​​ button.

Order and points Updates:​​
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968315/10e77424d64273001f11e8a0c2163a3d906fb8c6.png[/img]
Added points Exchange: Trade points for Void Breath, Void Crystals, or Chaos Crystals.
Order quality now scales with ​difficulty​ (previously VIP level).
Removed order slot unlocks and wait times; ​infinite orders​ are now available at beginning.
Orders may now request ​Chaos-tier items​ (unlocked at Orange Skull 1).
Reduced order affix requirement multipliers.

​New Scent Exchange:​​
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968315/18f3ffd99377e244d96d7203eea558312fde1b45.png[/img]
Unlocked at ​Orange Skull 1:
Trade Scent​ or ​Chaos Scent​ for Chaos Crystals, Perfect Void Crystals, or Relics.

​Other Adjustments:​​
Optimized late-game performance issues.
Increased save slots to ​8.
Now dropped items will have at least 1 affix of the same quality
Increased the affix roll range of +n% normal damage, +n% fire damage, +n% frost damage, +n% lightning damage in Slate
Flipped the ​Dark Tree​ and added visual guides.
Hunting Mission monster Life and Damage now scale with mission quality.
Added auto-pickup/disassemble filters for Chaos-tier Relics, Slates, and Hunting Cores.
Dropped items now guarantee ​at least 1 affix matching their quality.
Enhance items gain ​1 affix matching their new quality.
​Archer Core Talent - Chain: Projectile chains increased to ​4​ (was 2).
Slate - Chain: Projectile chains increased to ​2​ (was 1).
Adjusted Destruction Corpse’s Dash Slash behavior.
Added option to disable Abyssal Depth visual effects.
Hunter Cognition - Enhanced​ boss scaling to 2/4/8/16 (was 2/3/4/5).
Updated descriptions for multiple relics and slates.

​Bug Fixes:​​
Fixed Epic-tier and lower items allowing full affix locking during crafting.
Fixed Epic-item crafting without acquiring Epic-tier items.
Fixed the optional reminder affixes would sometimes be missing in the reminder interface
Fixed the ignite and poison caused by skills were not affected by the "Damage over time effect rate" on their Slates
Fixed resource display errors.
Fixed the ignite damage was not modified by Slate affix.
Fixed Poison damage anomalies.
Fixed damage reduction provided by endurance was abnormal at high stack
Fixed incorrect damage bonuses from ​Relic - Wing Blade.
Revised translation errors.

​Localization Plans:​​
Due to translation team shortages, some languages have critical errors. 
Now we have some hunters to help us check English translation, very thanks for their help XD!
If you willing to help us to do the translation work, pls join to our Discord !
And we plan to ​fully revise all supported languages​ for the official release.

​Thank you for your passion and patience, Hunters!​

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968315/2b4660e7cf024f103ba11e322d904bfe78a8d5da.png[/img]

notes.title: UPDATE PREVIEW 1.4
notes.notes:
Hi, Hunters, I'm BingX.

Firstly I'm sorry that the update of Dark Hunting Ground has been stagnant for a while. 

Keeping a player's role can help me think from the perspective of the player, which can help me develop the game better. I think this is as important as spending energy and time on game development. 

So I spent about 3 weeks to deeply experience the 0.2 version of "Path of Exile 2" and the 1.2 version of "Last Epoch", which really gave me a lot of new inspiration and thinking for the development of Dark Hunting Ground.

Next, I will start to prepare for the next major update (1.4) of the EA version of Dark Hunting Ground. This will be a more systematic update, which may modify the existing item system, item drop and crafting system.

It is expected that some new affixes will be added for limited drop acquisition. These affixes will be very powerful, and some affixes will be removed from the crafting system to ensure the rarity and importance of limited drop affixes. This will make the later item drops meaningful.

At the same time, I will also update the item decomposition retention system synchronously, so that when brushing items, you can keep the items you need by filtering rules.

The crafting system and the chaos system are also the parts I want to improve. I will take the opportunity of this major update to think about and try to improve them.

Some updates that affect the game experience will also be included, such as the optimization of the challenge process of the abyss, the optimization of the crafting process, etc.

Like the last major update, I will first launch the 1.4.0.0 Beta version and continue to update it. If you want to experience the new content of the game as soon as possible, and don’t mind the impact of possible bugs on the game experience, you are very welcome to use the 1.4.0.0 Beta version to play and give feedback and suggestions.

If you have any interesting ideas or suggestions for the game, please put them in the comments or give feedback in the player community.

Thank you forever for your support of the Dark Hunting Ground!

notes.title: THE COGNITION UPDATE 1.3.0.6

[h1]Hello Hunters[/h1]

[h2]It is finally tim for our First Major Update, called:
[b]The Cognition Update[/b].[/h2]

[h3]It was on Beta for few weeks and now it's going to the regular brench after several fixes. So here it is everything that is new on it:[/h3]

[u][h3]Cognition System:[/h3][/u]
After level 50, you won't get Talent Points for each upgrade, but you will get Cognition Points. 
Hunters can use Cognition Points to explore the potential value of things and unlock some new game content, including new core talents, new game features, etc.

notes.title: THE FIRST MAJOR UPDATE IS COMING SOON!
notes.notes:
[h3]Happy New Year Hunters![/h3]

This is the first week without an update for Dark Hunting Ground, partly due to the holidays and partly due to the preparations being made for the first [b]Major Update[/b] - Version 1.3.0.0, [u]The Cognition System[/u].

With the capping of the Cognition System, the Hunter level cap will be lifted and existing overflow experience will be converted into levels. after level 50, you will not gain Talent Points for each upgrade, but you will gain Cognition System. Hunters can use Cognition Points to discover the potential value of things as a way to unlock some new game content, including new core talents, new game features and more.

[u]The Cognition System is expected to go live next week or the week after[/u], and will continue to be augmented with future major updates, including a New Pathway, The Guardian.

[i]We thank all hunters for their support in 2024, and hope that 2025 will continue to be an enjoyable experience for you!![/i]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.2.1.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Hunters,[/h1]

[h3]It is time for a small update.[/h3]

[h2]Improvements and Additions:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Summon-Elemental changes:
Summoned Elementals will now use a skill that depends on the Damage Conversion Attribute with the largest value.
By default, Summoned Elementals will rotate through Fire, Cold, and Lightning, and if they have the Damage Conversion Attribute, the Summoned Elemental will use the skill that corresponds to the Damage Conversion Attribute with the largest value.
For example, if you have the Incremental Slate - Cold (100% Normal Damage to Elemental Damage), the Summoned Elemental's Summon will only use the Cold skill.
[*] Artifact - Nirvana Ghost Wings will now also increase damage dealt at low blood by a total of 30% (at full level)
[*] Thunder Power provided by Artifact - Tyrannical Thunder Spirit now also increases damage dealt by 4% per tier (at full level).
[*] The total damage dealt provided by Weak has been increased from 10% to 15%.
[*] Increased the additional chance of being struck from 25% to 35% provided by Fragile.
[*] Increased total increase in duration of benefits from Pattern of Continuation from 60% to 100% (Chaos quality)
[*] Extreme Balance increased from 60% to 200% increase in bludgeoning damage, but is now unique (Chaos quality)
[*] Cooldown recovery speed from Limit Principle increased from 50% to 80% (Chaos quality)
[*] Quick OK added to some UI
[*] Adjusted some out-of-screen UI
[/list]
[i]Have a great HUNT![/i]

notes.title: HOTFIX 1.0.5.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Hunters,[/h1]

[h3]It is time for another hotfix.[/h3]

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The button to terminate an abyss will now no longer appear at the abyss settlement site.
[*] Alerts for remodeled words can now be set to alert on Recast or Refine alone.
[*] New search bar at the Abyssal Forces icon.
[*] It is now possible to select the Abyssal power you wish to highlight in the Abyssal power graphic
[*] Added a setting to adjust the transparency of summons
[*] Added a setting to always show the player's life bar
[*] Amplification Slate affix "Skill Effect Duration" now also works on toxins and elemental anomalies caused by skills.
[*] Clockwork 3 now adds a "Trigger" tag to all skills.
[*] Clockwork 3 now causes skills to have a skill interval of 0 (as Amplification Slate - Auto did)
[*] The description of Clockwork 3 has been changed.
[*] Some underlying mechanisms have been adjusted so that some effects triggered by being hit can still be triggered normally even after killing the monster, including:
The Hermit's core talent-the spread of toxins provided by Poisoned Weapons
The Relic - The Pervading Breath
The Elementalist 3's Elemental Resonance
[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] A problem that the "Apply additional Poison" type of phrase did not take effect correctly
[*] Iron Warrior 3 was providing an anomalous Maximum Normal Resistance value.
[*] The "50% of elemental damage received is treated as Normal Damage" provided by Iron Warrior 3 wan't working properly.
[/list]
[i]Have a great HUNT![/i]

notes.title: HOTFIX 1.0.4.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Hunters,[/h1]

[h3]It is time again for another hotfix.[/h3]

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new leave button has been added to the abyss to immediately end the abyss and checkout.
[*] Added a confirmation window for resolution changes to avoid accidentally changing to an unplayable resolution.
[*] More attribute information has been added to the character panel.
[*] Effect transparency is now correctly applied to buff effects.
[*] Revised partial translation.
[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ignite wasn't doing damage when hit damage was too high.
[*] Fixed the issue where the "+80% Life Costing Skill's Damage" provided by Warrior‘s core talent - Animated flesh did not take effect  
[*] Summoning - Individuals will now be re-summoned after use so that attributes are updated in a timely manner (previously, when a Giant Energy Body survived, using the skill would only cause him to move his position).
[*] A buggy interaction of summons with Amplification Slate - Charge
[*] A Summoner's incorrect interaction with Amplification Slate - Trample
[*] Relic - Heart of Corruption sometimes wasn't applying corrosion correctly
[*] Relic - Bug Bottle sometimes wasn't copying toxins correctly
[*] Amplification Slate - Share wasn't taking effect
[*] Amplification Slate - Healing wasn't stacking.
[*] Amplification Slate - Lasting failing to extend Toxin Duration and Elemental Anomaly Duration
[*] Incorrect range damage total increase provided by Destroyer Enable 3 (expected to be 0-100%, prior to that it was actually 100%-200%)
[*] A issue where you could get duplicate boss quests by quick action when hunting consecutive bosses
[/list]
[i]Have a great HUNT![/i]
